evidence : str
    Concise evidence from the supplied snapshot and document context.
why_snapshot_metadata : str
    Reason the information describes the snapshot rather than only its document.
closest_schema_paths : list[str]

why_existing_fields_may_be_insufficient : str
    Possible semantic loss when using the closest existing paths.
material_impact : Literal["interpretability", "discoverability", "both"]
    Area materially affected if the information is not covered.
material_consequence : str
    Concrete impairment caused by omission or inadequate representation.
uncertainty_note : str | None
    Remaining evidential or materiality uncertainty, if any.

content.text: {"coverage_assessment":"possible_gap","critical_or_possible_gaps":[{"gap_id":"gap_001","gap_status":"possible","missing_metadata_concept":"Structured associations between subcomponents of a composite snapshot and their own titles, visualization forms, variables, temporal scopes, and comparators.","proposed_field_name":"component_structure","evidence":"The snapshot is a composite 'Annex 14: Country at a Glance' with multiple table sections ('POVERTY and SOCIAL', 'KEY ECONOMIC RATIOS and LONG-TERM TRENDS', 'STRUCTURE of the ECONOMY') and separate chart panels ('Development diamond*', 'Economic ratios*', 'Growth of investment and GDP (%)', 'Growth of exports and imports (%)'), each using different indicators, years, and comparison groups.","why_snapshot_metadata":"This describes the internal organization of the extracted snapshot itself: which visible subfigure or table section represents which measures, periods, and benchmarks. It is not only metadata about the parent Project Appraisal Document.","closest_schema_paths":["panel_titles","visualization_types[]","variables[]","dimensions[]","temporal_coverage.period","comparisons","subject_summary"],"why_existing_fields_may_be_insufficient":"The existing fields can flatten panel titles, visualization types, variables, dimensions, time expressions, and comparisons at the whole-snapshot level, but they do not preserve which variables, temporal coverage, comparators, or visualization type belong to each specific panel or section. For this snapshot, flattening could conflate demographic indicators, economic ratios, structure-of-economy tables, radar charts, and time-series charts.","material_impact":"interpretability","material_consequence":"A metadata consumer could know that the snapshot includes GDP, investment, life expectancy, exports, imports, Guinea, low-income comparators, and several years, but not reliably determine which concepts are represented together in each table section or chart panel, making the composite figure harder to interpret without viewing the image.","uncertainty_note":"This is only a possible gap because some information can be partially preserved through ordered panel_titles, broad visualization_types, variables, dimensions, comparisons, and a summary; the materiality depends on whether v1.2 is expected to support component-level interpretation for composite snapshots."}]}

critical_or_possible_gaps.missing_metadata_concept: Structured associations between subcomponents of a composite snapshot and their own titles, visualization forms, variables, temporal scopes, and comparators.
critical_or_possible_gaps.evidence: The snapshot is a composite 'Annex 14: Country at a Glance' with multiple table sections ('POVERTY and SOCIAL', 'KEY ECONOMIC RATIOS and LONG-TERM TRENDS', 'STRUCTURE of the ECONOMY') and separate chart panels ('Development diamond*', 'Economic ratios*', 'Growth of investment and GDP (%)', 'Growth of exports and imports (%)'), each using different indicators, years, and comparison groups.
critical_or_possible_gaps.why_snapshot_metadata: This describes the internal organization of the extracted snapshot itself: which visible subfigure or table section represents which measures, periods, and benchmarks. It is not only metadata about the parent Project Appraisal Document.
critical_or_possible_gaps.why_existing_fields_may_be_insufficient: The existing fields can flatten panel titles, visualization types, variables, dimensions, time expressions, and comparisons at the whole-snapshot level, but they do not preserve which variables, temporal coverage, comparators, or visualization type belong to each specific panel or section. For this snapshot, flattening could conflate demographic indicators, economic ratios, structure-of-economy tables, radar charts, and time-series charts.
critical_or_possible_gaps.material_consequence: A metadata consumer could know that the snapshot includes GDP, investment, life expectancy, exports, imports, Guinea, low-income comparators, and several years, but not reliably determine which concepts are represented together in each table section or chart panel, making the composite figure harder to interpret without viewing the image.
critical_or_possible_gaps.uncertainty_note: This is only a possible gap because some information can be partially preserved through ordered panel_titles, broad visualization_types, variables, dimensions, comparisons, and a summary; the materiality depends on whether v1.2 is expected to support component-level interpretation for composite snapshots.
